symbols.read: Price has pushed to 735.87, pressing directly against the 737.02 invalidation line and flipping the 4H direction to bullish, so the neutral-to-bearish stance is now on the verge of being wrong rather than merely uncommitted. The SELL setup at 722.40 remains invalidated and the combined signal holds at HOLD, but the regime is now BULLISH and the 1H stays up despite the last bar dropping 739.41→734.25, meaning the cushion above 722.40 has widened into a full recovery. Levels are unchanged: a close above 737.02 confirms the flip toward the 758.44 upper pivot, while losing 722.40 revives the bearish case toward 686.36. The change from the prior read is the 4H trend flip to bullish and price sitting at the stop level rather than below it, which revises the bias from neutral-to-bearish to neutral pending the 737.02 break; invalidation of any remaining downside lean is a sustained move above 737.02.

The short from 4,141.44 is now invalidated: price pushed to 4,143.24 on the last 1H bar, trading through the 4,141.44 pivot and above the 4,148.48 stop zone intraday before closing back at 4,131.38, so the rejection trigger never held. A sustained reclaim above 4,148.48 flips the structure neutral-to-bullish and kills the downside case; holding below 4,141.44 keeps 4,065.48 in play.

Bias flips to neutral-to-bullish: price has reclaimed the 1.31 lower pivot and is now trading at 1.32, which invalidates the prior bearish read's core condition (a sustained hold back above 1.31) and confirms the level break the previous read flagged as the whole story. The 1H trend remains up even as the last hour pulled back 1.34→1.32 (-1.61%), and the combined 4H+1H signal holds at HOLD with the SELL setup still invalidated, so the bearish structure is now shelved rather than active. The immediate level is 1.32 holding as support; a sustained push above opens the 1.43 upper pivot, while a drop back below 1.31 would revive the 1.20 target. Invalidation of this neutral-to-bullish stance: a sustained break back under 1.31.
